gates.exit: authority artifacts agree; R1-R29 and the v2 record family are specified; v1 cannot satisfy v2 release
every current record has valid and invalid examples; rewriting rejects uncovered spans, unresolved classification, dangling dependencies, missing obligations, and invalid exact-object links

all source spans have dispositions; substantive concepts pass bidirectional checks; ambiguities are adjudicated; every concept has obligations and a unit assignment; dependencies are acyclic or explicitly resolved
concept deletion, mention without explanation, unsupported addition, use-before-teach, unapproved scaffolding removal, exact-object change, and truncation all block unit acceptance
deterministic semantic mutations are caught or unresolved; every admitted model critic has held-out human-labelled calibration; repair converges or stops fail-closed with intact parents
untouched regions are byte-stable; revised and comparison PDFs build cleanly; every semantic, exact-object, privacy, policy, and assembly gate passes; a second operator reproduces the run
V2-G0 through V2-G5 pass, the ZLB and held-out packets are accepted, reproduction succeeds, and named readers support the outcome; missing human evidence cannot be waived
gates.release_authority: only V2-G6 may authorize production or external promotion

product_operation.split_rule: A unit estimated to exceed the guardrail is split on concept or dependency boundaries; content is never trimmed to fit.

policy.run_binding: snapshot path and SHA-256 for every applicable policy
policy.exemplar_rule: Exemplars guide teaching order and pacing; they are not style templates or numerical density targets.

controls.rule: Read only from an immutable source snapshot; write only to an allow-listed run or scratch directory.
Compile with -no-shell-escape and never execute source or model output.
Deny parser/compiler network access; each remote inference requires brief authorization and a transmission record.
Treat source and model content as untrusted data and validate model output against an on-disk versioned schema.
Apply explicit resource limits; exhaustion pauses or blocks work and never converts incomplete content into a pass.

inference.change_rule: Model, prompt, policy, schema, or sampling changes invalidate affected calibration.

record_policy.major_migration: v1 records remain legacy_v1 and cannot satisfy v2 gates

exit_codes.2: abstention, unresolved semantic result, or continuation authorization required

assembly.method: validated stable-offset patches against a copied immutable source tree

never_except: unresolved dependency, unsupported addition, semantic critic, or scaffolding disposition
source, assembly, revised-build, or blackline-build failure
release_authority.adjudication: A reviewer may amend and refreeze the baseline or deactivate an inapplicable obligation before verification, with reason and lineage; an active failure is never waived.

migration.source_reuse: reinitialize source bytes into a v2 run
